verdict.rationale: LiteLLM ships an official Python SDK plus a proxy that mirrors the OpenAI SDK interface, letting developers build against a familiar, documented API surface across 100+ providers (litellm-docs-1,2,16,17; litellm-gh-1). However, community evidence raises reliability and supply-chain security concerns (flakiness, a compromised PyPI release) that add real caveats to trusting the SDK in production (litellm-comm-1,4,11).
